defect.id: L1 (WS22 SCORING_INTEGRITY section 2) == WS17 ERROR_DECOMPOSITION section 0
defect.class: SELECTION ON THE OUTCOME (not a peeking leak)
defect.statement: the scorer refused every forecast row whose player had no record in actuals. actuals emits a record only for a player who recorded at least one target, carry or dropback, so an absent record in a completed game is the observed value ZERO, and the refused rows were exactly the rows where the model forecast volume and the player produced none -- the over-forecasts.
defect.change_class: EVALUATION-ONLY. No projection, no draw, no price, no board and no freeze moves.

nfl/research/model_health/MODEL_HEALTH_2.second_defect_found_while_correcting: its rows come from TWO different game populations: the four receiving/rushing rows reproduce a 7-game run, the seven QB rows reproduce an 8-game run. No field in the artifact said so, and it had no build script anywhere in the repository. The corrected artifact is built by nfl/research/model_health/build_health.py from one run over one population.

nfl/research/SUNDAY_1PM_OUTCOME_AUDIT.js.note: WS-F does not own nfl/research/ and did not touch this file. Its 7-game scope is also now historical: it excluded 2026_01_NO_DET as NOT FINAL on GAME_CLOCK_EXPIRED, and the finality guard has since been corrected for overtime, so that game is final against the same blob today.

reproduction_of_the_superseded_numbers.method: the repaired module carries --legacy-outcome-selection, which reproduces the pre-repair rule and stamps the run as a known leak. On the 7-game scope it returns 268 scored rows and 369 refusals and reproduces every published cell of SUNDAY_1PM_OUTCOME_AUDIT.json; on the 8-game scope it returns 335 rows and reproduces the QB cells of MODEL_HEALTH_2026-09-13.json.

independent_confirmation.WS17_carries_survives: carries -3.1244 -> -1.7775, game-clustered z -3.39 on 5 game clusters. WS17 reported -3.73 for the same point estimate; the point estimate reproduces exactly and the z differs by SE convention. Under the convention written into _cluster_se (CRVE with the G/(G-1) finite-cluster correction) it is -3.39; without the correction -3.79; from the spread of per-game cluster means -3.65. The direction and order of magnitude are the same under all three and no adequacy claim rests on which is used.

same-day-retrospective.why: the scored SET changed. A 2.0.0 statistic may not be compared with a 1.0.0 one.

market-outcome-audit.why: the graded SET changed, for the same reason. Latent on the only gradable slate, but the rule that decides which comparisons exist is different, and a hit rate from 2.0.0 is not comparable with one from 1.0.0 in general.

model-health.why: FIELDS gained four entries (n_zero_completed_rows, n_game_clusters, outcome_selection_basis, market_selection_basis) and WARNINGS gained two (OUTCOME_CONDITIONAL_SELECTION, MARKET_STATS_OUTCOME_SELECTED). No existing field changed meaning and none was removed, so this is not the 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0 break the retrospective correctly took. Leaving the string at 1.0.0 would have been worse than either: a consumer keying on 1.0.0 would read a different schema under the same name.
model-health.published_artifact_quotes: MODEL_HEALTH_2026-09-13.json carries spec_version model-health/1.0.0 and is NOT rewritten. What changed under that name is the six additions listed above; nothing that existed at 1.0.0 changed meaning, so every field that file publishes still means what it said.

provenance_hole_recorded_not_fixed.finding: A PUBLISHED ARTIFACT THAT NO CODE IN THE REPOSITORY CAN REGENERATE.
provenance_hole_recorded_not_fixed.two_populations: its four receiving/rushing rows reproduce a SEVEN-game run of same_day_retrospective (receiving n=48, rushing/carries n=12); its seven QB rows reproduce an EIGHT-game run (qb n=18, bias -7.2284, mae 8.5721, crps 6.2938, cov50 0.5556). Each cell was pinned by exact match on n and mean_signed_error. No field in the artifact states either scope, so any comparison across layers inside it compares different samples.
provenance_hole_recorded_not_fixed.no_build_script: nfl/product/model_health.py defines the contract and is imported by no module in the repository; assert_ranking_admissible has no caller. Nothing in the tree assembles the published file, and the two-population mix means no single invocation of anything could have.
provenance_hole_recorded_not_fixed.disposition: RECORDED, NOT FIXED, on coordinator ruling 2026-09-14. The missing build script is NOT reconstructed: an artifact no code can regenerate is a finding, not a task. nfl/research/model_health/build_health.py builds the CORRECTED artifact from one run over one population; it is not a reconstruction of how the superseded file was made, and it could not be, because that file was assembled from two runs.

market_grader_repair.defect: the identical selection leak: a quote was refused NO_REALISED_VALUE ("not imputed") whenever actuals carried no record for the player, which in a completed game is the observed value zero.
market_grader_repair.direction: NOT NEUTRAL, AND IT FLATTERS US. A priced player who recorded nothing settles UNDER at every line the book offered, and the model-selected side on such a player is very often OVER, because the forecast that put volume on him is what generated the disagreement. The deleted set is therefore enriched in comparisons the model LOSES, and any hit rate, mean gap or bucket table computed on the survivors reads better than the same statistic over every comparison actually made.

measured_exposure.slate: frozen 1 PM snapshot, sha16 98dbe0713d56d27d, 343 quotes, 8 games
measured_exposure.reading: the refusal NEVER FIRED on the only gradable slate. The defect was real in code and latent in effect, so the published market figures are NOT contaminated by it. It is repaired anyway: "it has not bitten yet" is not a property of the code, and the first priced player who is inactive, ejected or simply never touches the ball would have triggered it silently and in one direction.

market_grader_repair.effect_of_the_repair: NONE on this slate, verified: the repaired grader reproduces the legacy run byte for byte -- all 343 CSV rows identical, summaries identical apart from the selection stamp, and every cell of the published SUNDAY_MARKET_OUTCOME_AUDIT.json clean result and by-market table reproduced exactly.
market_grader_repair.consequence_for_this_artifact: because the repaired grader declares a complete selection and reproduces the carried columns exactly, the carried market columns in MODEL_HEALTH_2026-09-14_ZERO_COMPLETED.json are declared COMPLETE_INCLUDING_ZERO_BY_COMPLETION with a written justification, and MARKET_STATS_OUTCOME_SELECTED clears on all nine metrics that carry them. Ranking eligibility is UNCHANGED at 1 of 11: no metric was promoted by the clearing.

superseded.status: SUPERSEDED, NOT MODIFIED, NOT DELETED. WS-F does not own nfl/research/.

market_grader_repair.clustering_added: perf() now emits game-clustered and player-game-clustered SEs of the hit rate over DECIDED comparisons only, and emits no naive binomial SE. Clean stratum: hit 0.4444 on 81 decided quotes, naive 0.0552, game-clustered 0.0724 on FOUR game clusters (1.31x wider), player-game-clustered 0.0631 on 37 player-game clusters. The graded non-QB markets exist in only four of the eight games, which a quote count of 81 entirely conceals.
market_grader_repair.the_4_25_slate: still DEFERRED, not refused: the authoritative source carries 10 games and none of ARI_LAC, GB_MIN, MIA_LV, WAS_PHI. Unchanged by this repair.

what_this_does_not_establish: nothing here is a test. One slate, 5 or 9 game clusters, no predeclared equivalence margin, no TOST.
no metric is called unbiased, stable, closed or correct. A bias that no longer reaches |z| = 2 on nine clusters has not been shown to be absent.
pit_mean is carried forward uninterpretable: pit_of applies one shared uniform to every row (WS22 item 11). That defect is NOT repaired here, deliberately, so that exactly one thing changed.

the market columns are carried forward unmodified. The grader that produced them carried the same selection leak at spec 1.0.0; at 2.0.0 it does not, and it reproduces them cell for cell, which is what licenses declaring their basis complete. That is a statement about SELECTION only -- it says nothing about whether the hit rates are informative, and on 4 game clusters they are not.
this is a diagnostic. It is not prospective evidence, counts toward no sample floor and clears no blocker.
